name: Seelinder
aliases: Rotating LED array volumetric display with parallax barrier
Seelinder — Cylindrical 3D display with parallax barrier
definition: A cylindrical 3D display using a parallax barrier with multiple slits and a 1D LED array rotating along the slits. It utilizes the scanning of light rays when slit and LED positions change to reproduce multiple viewpoints in 360 degrees.
summary: Seelinder is a 360-degree autostereoscopic volumetric display that uses a rotating cylindrical parallax barrier and a 1D LED array to generate multiple viewpoints without a full 360-degree LED source.
